title: Spec-check answers that change a slice's text are applied before the run
lead: *Proposed.* When an owner's spec-check answer changes a slice's text (a Check line, a test name), the change is made in the slice before its Check lines run: either ork tells the implementer to make it as its first step and the reviewer confirms it, or the slice-check runner refuses a backticked Check entry that is not a command and names it.
findings_note: S241 (2026-11-16, run ork-20261116-015040-d93b): the owner answered the spec check's Check question with "tighten" (drop `go -C WORKTREE run ./cmd/ork help` and "the `--yes` flags"). The implementer did not edit the Check section, so S317's slice-check runner ran the backticked `--yes` as a command and the run paused ("exec: \"--yes\": executable file not found"). The orchestrator edited the Check by hand and retried.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* S317 runs a slice's backticked Check lines; any unrunnable line left in the spec now pauses a run at the gate, after the whole relay has run.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/brief.go` (`specAnswersSection`: the implementer's "apply the owner's spec answers first" and the reviewer's confirm section; `sliceChecks`: an entry whose first word starts with `-` is not a command)
- `internal/engine/round.go:483` (`runRound`: adds the section after the Owner decisions section)
- `internal/engine/states.go:978` (`runSliceChecks`: unchanged; it records the row's not-run reason and runs no command)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go`
- `internal/engine/slicechecks_test.go`
- `docs/design.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestImplementerBriefSaysToApplySpecAnswersFirst`: a run with a spec answer that names a Check change puts it under its own heading in the implementer brief, as the first step.
- `TestSliceChecksSkipAFlagOnlyEntry`: a backticked Check entry that starts with `-` is reported as not a command, not run.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red tests above.
2. Code and brief text.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.
